parameters.help_en: The instance identity of the associated product. When you invoke the operation, you must use an instance that you have access to and that actually exists. The instance must be consistent with the instance to which the scenario, channel, and session belong. The maximum length is subject to the current POP parameter definition
parameters.help_zh: 所属产品的实例标识。必须使用调用者有权访问且确实存在的实例；应与场景、渠道和会话所属实例保持一致。最大长度以当前POP参数定义为准
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the dialog scenario under the instance. Specify an existing scenario. Subsequent dialog and termination requests for the same text session must use the scenario specified when the session was started
parameters.help_zh: 实例下的对话场景标识。请填写实际存在的场景；同一文本会话的后续对话和结束请求应使用开启会话时的场景
parameters.name: script_id

parameters.help_en: The session ID used to uniquely associate this interaction. For a text session, it is the identifier starting with text- returned when the session is started. For a web voice session, it is the identifier starting with ws-. For a real number outbound call test, it is the identifier starting with test-. Subsequent calls must use the actual returned value
parameters.help_zh: 用于唯一关联本次交互的会话标识。文本会话为开启会话返回的text-标识，网页语音为ws-标识，真实号码外呼测试为test-标识；后续调用必须使用实际返回值
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: The visitor token obtained from the trial link. It is used to locate the trial channel and verify access permissions and validity. The token is generated by the channel service and must not be constructed manually. It cannot be empty and must still be within its validity period. The example is a placeholder value that cannot be used for authentication. Do not disclose the actual token to unauthorized personnel
parameters.help_zh: 从体验链接取得的访客令牌，用于定位试用渠道并校验访问权限和有效期。令牌由渠道服务生成，不应自行构造；不能为空，且必须仍在有效期内。示例为不可用于认证的占位值，请勿将真实令牌泄露给无关人员
parameters.name: visitor_token

schema.description_en: The business response for this API operation. A Code of OK indicates success, and Data contains the corresponding business result. For business errors, troubleshoot by checking Message and Params
schema.description_zh: 本次API的业务响应，Code=OK表示成功，Data为对应业务结果；业务错误结合Message及Params排查

Code.description_en: The business processing status code. OK indicates success. If an exception occurs, the corresponding business error code is returned. The error types and mapping rules follow the current API configuration. No error codes are added or modified in this operation
Code.description_zh: 业务处理状态码，OK表示成功；发生异常时返回对应的业务错误码。错误类型和映射规则沿用当前API配置，本次不新增或修改错误码

Data.description_en: The SessionId of the text session ended in this request, which corresponds to the SessionId in the request. The termination service still returns this ID even if the context has expired
Data.description_zh: 本次结束的文本会话SessionId，与请求SessionId对应；上下文已过期时结束服务仍返回该标识

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code recorded in the business response body. A normal return value is 200. To determine whether the business operation is successful, you must also check Code. You cannot determine the success of the call solely based on the presence of this field
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: 业务响应体记录的HTTP状态码，正常返回为200。判断业务是否成功还应检查Code，不能仅凭该字段存在认定调用成功

Message.description_en: The business response or error message. It is typically empty or not returned upon success. Do not expect a fixed text string upon success. Upon failure, it provides an error description to assist with troubleshooting. Use it in conjunction with Code and Params to identify the cause of the error. The example shows an error message for an expired visitor token in an experience link (corresponding to the Expired.VisitorToken code) and serves as a format reference only
Message.description_zh: 业务响应或错误说明。成功时通常为空或不返回，不能要求成功时固定返回某段文本；失败时为错误说明，用于辅助排查，并结合Code与Params理解错误原因。示例为体验链接访客令牌过期时的错误消息（对应Code为Expired.VisitorToken），仅作格式参考

Params.description_en: The list of parameters used for the localized display of error messages. These are not scenario variables or business results. A normal successful response usually returns an empty array. When an error occurs, parameters corresponding to the error template may be returned
Params.description_zh: 用于错误消息本地化展示的参数列表，不是场景变量或业务结果。正常成功响应通常为空数组；出现错误时可能返回与错误模板对应的参数

items.description_en: A parameter value in the error message template. The specific content is determined by the current error. The example InstanceId only demonstrates a possible field name and does not indicate that this value is returned in every call
items.description_zh: 错误消息模板中的一个参数值。具体内容由本次错误决定；示例InstanceId仅演示可能的字段名，不表示每次调用均返回该值

RequestId.description_en: The ID used to associate and troubleshoot this POP request. The value in the response corresponds to the current request. System request parameters are injected by the gateway, and the caller does not need to fill in system fields
RequestId.description_zh: 用于关联和排查本次POP请求的标识。响应中的值对应本次请求；系统请求参数由网关注入，调用者不需要自行填写系统字段
